goals.objective: Goal 1: Read-first and preflight. Capture full-document source receipt, current git/process/DB stale-row state, and exact blocker reproduction facts without starting a new long OOS run. Build at least three hypotheses, inspect cli/warm_session.py, cli/runner.py, backtest engine handshake paths, configs, process counts, and existing blocker logs, then identify root cause or a narrow blocked reason. Goal 3: If a safe fix or workaround exists, implement only the minimal scoped change or operational workaround, add focused verification, and commit in Korean. If no safe fix exists, document why later goals are blocked. Goal 4: Retry only the preregistered rank02 selected two OOS with a new run_id, official min full-period warm64, and stop if honest rows are not produced. Do not run non-selected OOS. Goal 5: If honest OOS rows exist, classify survivor/hold/no_go and only then append survivor and seed_pool records append-only with next seed readiness. If no survivor exists, document Plan D blocked terminal state. Goal 6: If a next Plan D round opens safely, continue the same pattern: dry-run, INSERT-only, limited replay, preregistered selected OOS, handoff, ledger, verification receipt, and Korean commit. Stop at portfolio/export/live/final boundary and write terminal handoff.
